notice.label: Notice
notice.title: Kura Finance LLC has been dissolved and has ceased operations.
notice.intro: What remains is an open-source wallet that is no longer maintained. While it keeps working, you can still use the basics, including but not limited to:
items: Holding and sending digital dollars and crypto
Earning and borrowing on Morpho markets (rates are variable and you can lose money)
notice.keys: If you need to export your private keys, you can do so on Privy.
notice.openSourceLead: The entire project is open source on GitHub.
notice.openSourceBody: Anyone can fork it and run their own version, including the Bridge (fiat ramp) and Dinari (US stocks) integrations. To run those, you need your own partner contracts, licenses and KYC.

cta.title: Kura has ceased operations.
cta.description: This site is kept as an archive of what Kura offered. The features described here are no longer available. What remains is an open-source wallet that is not maintained.
